name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.9.3 adds a self-contained macOS app-icon fixer applet: once allowed under App Management it replaces the bundle icon in place (verified on this machine), keeping the v0.9.2 removals. v0.9.2 removed the composer cogitation gauge. v0.9.1: themed expanded command-row icons. v0.9.0: themed macOS app icon, readable recommendation badge, Mars-red primary button in queue/steer/stop states. v0.8.0: boot prelude, telemetry rail, reasoning slider. macOS + Windows verified. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿。
